name: Space Marine
bio: Short, green and fully kitted out. Passed every fitness test by standing on a crate.
notes: Drive, 2026-11-02 ("space marine uniform", rigged; the owner's download "Meshy_AI_space_marine_uniform_All_Animations.glb", put on disk by the lead with the owner's approval). A rigged Meshy download ("All Animations": Mixamo joint names, read as Meshy's; its Walking and Running clips are not used). A CC0 Meshy community model that the owner rigged and animated on their Meshy account (licence per the owner, 2 Nov), recorded like WWII Infantry and the clip set's sources (content/clip-sets/shooter.json). It moves with the shared clip set. Despite the download's name it is a short, green-skinned, pointy-eared alien in a red uniform (0.91 m in the download): small, with goblin bot names. Name a placeholder.

source.author: Meshy community (author not recorded; CC0 per the owner)
